title: dart_test.yaml: register the dashboard and i18n @Tags used by dashboard_todays_missions_heading_test.dart

evidence.quote: # Prevents "unknown tag" warnings when running `flutter test --tags`.

why: dart_test.yaml's tags: registry states its own purpose is to 'prevent "unknown tag" warnings when running flutter test --tags', and registers overflow: and settings:, but never dashboard: or i18n: anywhere in the file. Confirmed by execution: every run of this file prints 'Warning: Tags were used that weren't specified in dart_test.yaml. dashboard was used in the suite itself / i18n was used in the suite itself.' 10 other files also use the dashboard tag and 2 more use i18n, so every one of those runs repeats the same warning noise in local/CI output, burying real signal.
recommendation: Add `dashboard:` and `i18n:` entries to dart_test.yaml's tags: block alongside the existing overflow:/settings: entries.
acceptance_criteria: dart_test.yaml declares dashboard: and i18n: tags.
`flutter test test/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_todays_missions_heading_test.dart` prints no 'Tags were used that weren't specified' warning.
mergedFrom: Register epic_28/story_i4 tags in dart_test.yaml so the tag registry stays a working typo guard
